name: Veil Masquerade #05
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Crescent. Aperture: Twin slits. Ornament: Dotted grid. Palette: Gold + lilac. Hem: Straight. Its palette is the only one of its kind in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
